Yamato: "Wow! It's all cleaned up!"
Sisk: "Of course. Mr. Bart got all sorts of supplies ready,
so it was finished sooner than I expected."
Touya: "Huh... So that means you'll be able to make
a wider range of dishes now?"
Sisk: "Yes. Look forward to it."
Xiujian: "...Is it fixed?"
Touya: "Hmm? Hey, you were curious too?"
Xiujian: "Of course. Food nurtures an upright spirit,
and creates a healthy body. It is unthinkable
to neglect it."
That's certainly true.
Really?
Xiujian: "Hmm. Food, nurtured by heaven's blessings and the earth's love,
is the first happiness given to people. Too many forget that,
and take it for granted..."
Xiujian: "...How lamentable...
Food is nurtured by heaven's blessings and the earth's love,
the first happiness given to people.
Forgetting that and taking it for granted
is a failing of modern thought."
Sisk: "Wow! Well said!
I think we'd get along!
Oh, right. Come over here a moment!"
Xiujian: "Huh... Ah, no..."
Yamato: "Oh... They've gone out...
Where did she take him, I wonder?"
Touya: "...Who knows? Well, let's go somewhere else too."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
Yamato: "Huh? The elevator's moving. You don't see that often.
Is someone on it, I wonder?"
Touya: "Well, people do ride it."
Yamato: "But every time I look, it's stopped.
Right on the floor I'm on, too."
Touya: "You're imagining things. Imagining things. Anyway..."
Yamato: "Oh, it stopped."
Fain: "Hahahahaha!
To defend my beloved, the blade of justice smites the enemy!
With crimson blood burning red, such is a man's path in life!
A man of justice and truth!
Faaain, Jiiin, Baaaarion!!
I have arrived! For justice... I can die!"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "Aah!"
Fain: "H-Hey! Don't ignore me!
I was waiting specially for you..."
Touya: "...Get Gabon to take a look at you sometime."
Fain: "What?! I couldn't be healthier!
I'm not weak enough to get sick!
Dahahahaha!"
Yamato: "...It's a serious case."
Fain: "...So, what did you think? I'm pretty confident
in this one. Ah, my own talent frightens me."
It's pretty good, isn't it?
It's like enka.
Fain: "Isn't it? Especially the last part!
I get a thrill just saying it."
Yamato: "He's lost in admiration of himself... It's terminal."
Touya: "R-Right. Well, keep at it."
Fain: "'Enka'? What's that?"
Yamato: "Hmm... Maybe something like 'the song of the Japanese
heart'?"
Fain: "Heart? You mean a song that resonates
straight through the soul?"
Yamato: "W-Well, something like that."
Fain: "Oh! So my proclamation is just that
magnificent!"
Yamato: "Y-Yeah... Maybe..."
Fain: "Dahahahaha! You understand perfectly!"
Yamato: "By the way, Fain, why are you so
straightforward?"
Fain: "Heh heh heh... Because I believe in justice!
Dying for it would be my heart's desire!
And that justice is also for protecting those I hold dear!"
Touya: "Huh. Those you hold dear, eh..."
Fain: "Yes! For the princess, for Miss Ymir,
and for K-Kasumi... No! My justice is not
so fickle! Oh, what am I to do...?"
Yamato: "...What do we do?"
Touya: "Better keep our distance..."
Fain: "We're friends, aren't we?!
Tell me, who am I supposed to fight for?
I've decided in my heart that I'll love only one woman.
But I bear the noble and supreme
duty of guarding the princess. I can abandon neither love nor loyalty.
Ah... What a trial! This is the fate of a knight!
Then I shall press on! To fight destiny!
No, wait. But if one desires too much at once,
it's the same as losing everything, as my master said.
Does that mean I must follow one path or the other?!
Oh! How can this be?!
And choosing between Miss Ymir and Kasumi...
Damn it! It's all because those ≪Ze=Ode≫ bastards...
If not for them, I would never have had to suffer
like this...
Wait! Is this their conspiracy?!
Grrrrr! Damn them... How despicable...
No, how fearsome ≪Ze=Ode≫ is!
But I, Fain Jin Barion, will not let a little thing like that
break my spirit! Hmm? Does that mean,
to turn their plan against them, I must preserve my love for two women
and my loyalty to the princess
all at once?
No, but then I'd be defying my master's teaching.
Aaaah! What am I supposed to doooo?!"
Fain: "...Huh? Touya? Heeey..."
Yamato: "...He has it hard too."
Touya: "Well, he seems to find it fulfilling in his own way.
Anyway, let's go."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
Touya: "Hmm? Isn't that... Fain?"
Yamato: "It is... But he came out of Kasumi's room,
didn't he?"
Touya: "...That's what it looked like to me too."
Kasumi: "Oh, Touya-chan. What's up?"
Touya: "It looked like Fain just came out of there..."
Kasumi: "Yes, he did."
Yamato: "Kasumi, you and Fain...?"
Kasumi: "Hmm? Fain-kun only helped me
carry my things.
Is there something wrong with that?"
Touya: "Your things?"
Kasumi: "I could manage clothes and things by myself,
but I couldn't carry all my books...
Then Fain-kun happened to pass by."
Touya: "And he offered to carry them, right?"
Kasumi: "Yes. How did you know?"
Touya: "Well, after the way he was acting earlier,
there's no way he would've just left you there."
Kasumi: "Fain-kun's a bit like you in some ways, Touya-chan."
Touya: "Really?"
Kasumi: "Yes. You're both honest and straightforward, and kind."
Yamato: "I think he has a very clear purpose
behind what he does, though..."
Kasumi: "?"
Touya: "Are all your things sorted out now?
I'll help if there's anything else."
Kasumi: "No, it's fine. I just have to put things in order now."
Touya: "Okay. Well, if you need anything, don't hesitate to ask."
Kasumi: "Yeah, I will."
Touya: "See you."
Touya: "Hey."
Celica: "Oh, Touya. What's up?"
Touya: "Hmm? Well, I don't really need anything in particular."
Celica: "Hmm. Then I'll give you a mission:
keep this seat warm for me."
Touya: "Huh?"
Celica: "You're free, aren't you?"
Touya: "I'm not that free! See you!"
Celica: "Oh..."
Celica: "Wandering around in search of someone new to meet, maybe?"
Touya: "Of course not!"
Celica: "True. Touya, you don't seem like the type
to go out actively looking for love."
Touya: "Then what type do I seem like?"
Celica: "Hmm... Things you do without really thinking about them
move someone's heart, and it all works out before you know it.
Touya: "As if anything that convenient happens."
Celica: "Well, you'll find out eventually.
Now then, I'd better get going."
